company.name: Coinrule
company.shortDescription: Coinrule is a fintech firm that specializes in the automation of cryptocurrencies, decentralized finance, exchange-traded funds, and stocks.
company.description: Coinrule is an automated trading platform designed to facilitate intelligent AI-driven investments across various investment platforms and asset classes. It empowers cryptocurrency investors to develop and evaluate automated trading strategies, allowing them to capitalize on market opportunities while safeguarding against unfavorable events. The platform was established with the goal of democratizing access to trading strategies and models, which have traditionally been exclusive to investment banks and hedge funds, making them available to all investors.

productsAndServices.description: A no-code platform for creating and running automated trading strategies across cryptocurrencies, stocks, and ETFs through connected exchanges, brokers, and blockchains.
productsAndServices.name: Coinrule Automated Trading Platform

productsAndServices.description: A visual rule builder and library of more than 350 pre-built strategies for creating trading bots without programming, including DCA, grid, trend-following, stop-loss, and portfolio-rebalancing strategies.
productsAndServices.name: Coinrule Strategy Builder and Bot Templates

productsAndServices.description: A strategy-testing environment that lets users evaluate trading rules with virtual funds and historical or live market data before connecting them to a live exchange or broker.
productsAndServices.name: Coinrule Backtesting and Demo Exchange

productsAndServices.description: An integration based on the Model Context Protocol that allows compatible AI assistants to inspect portfolios and manage Coinrule strategies through natural-language instructions.
productsAndServices.name: Coinrule MCP and AI Trading Automation

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for monitoring and managing Coinrule trading bots, creating rules, viewing portfolios, and receiving notifications on iOS and Android devices.
productsAndServices.name: Coinrule Mobile App
